title: Tally Reports to Google Sheets
seoTitle: Automate Tally Reports into Google Sheets
seoDescription: Send sales, outstanding and stock reports from TallyPrime to Google Sheets automatically every day, so managers see live numbers without exports.
summary: Automated Tally reporting pushes sales, receivables, payables and stock figures from TallyPrime into Google Sheets on a schedule, so owners and managers see up-to-date numbers on any device without asking the accounts team for exports.

dataPoints.label: Typical reports
dataPoints.value: Daily sales by customer and item, outstanding receivables with ageing, stock summary

dataPoints.label: Frequency
dataPoints.value: Hourly or daily, depending on need and Tally availability

dataPoints.label: Requirement
dataPoints.value: A small connector running on the machine or server where Tally runs

body:
## Why Sheets first

Google Sheets is familiar, shareable and easy to chart. When needs grow, the same data can feed a dashboard tool. See [Tally and Power BI](/integrations/tally-power-bi).

## Access control

Share only the sheets each person needs, and keep financial sheets in the company workspace, not personal drives.

For the reverse direction, see [Google Sheets to Tally](/integrations/google-sheets-tally).

Tool features and APIs change; confirm current capabilities before scoping.

faqs.q: Does Tally need to stay open?
faqs.a: The connector needs Tally running with the company loaded at sync times, or Tally on a server.

faqs.q: Can we get WhatsApp alerts too?
faqs.a: Yes. Thresholds such as overdue receivables can trigger WhatsApp messages.
